'''2007 North Dakota State Championship Mark Peterson LS Tatooine: City Outskirts''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mark Peterson]] at [[2007 North Dakota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: City Outskirts|Tat-L-tatooinecityoutskirts.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Hyperdrive
* '''Username:''' lukes bionic hand
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
